Bill date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD

Printed total amount beside labels such as Total Amount, Bill Amount, or Total Due on the bill footer only. Do NOT use Grand Total or Net Payable values here when those are separate configured fields. Copy the exact printed value. Do NOT sum or calculate from bill_items.

- Copy each value only from the printed label described for that field_key.
- NEVER sum bill_items to populate any footer field.
